cc:Work.dc:title: Operationalising relations
cc:Work.dc:description: Two rows of small diagrams compare how networks are operationalised. The top row shows fixed nodes with category fills, ties of varying thickness by frequency, and identical nodes at two time points. The bottom row shows nodes as clusters of instances, ties typed as generative or extractive, a band marking assignment by the order that some ties cross and others reproduce, and a recurring pattern of generative ties across changing nodes.
